excerpt.zh: 万华镜犹如一道敞开的窗口，让我们的天空充满了不祥而病态的图案。我们的祭祀认为这是凶兆。也许明智的做法是牺牲一些能量给这个生物，消除它的饥饿，平息我们人民的恐惧。
excerpt.en: The Kaleidoscope throbs like an open wound, filling our skies with ominous, sickly patterns. Our priests believe it an ill omen. It may be wise to sacrifice some energy to the creature, to quench its hunger and appease our people's fears.

label.en: We shall not bend to its will.
